name: The First Reopening
summary: The first modern Titan Gate opens under impossible pressure. The Creator learns how Titans, Gates, Hollow leakage, and Director governance function.
loreDirectorNotes: Introduces canon without adding playable Heroes or ordinary units. Mesha and the Hollow Mouth are non-playable narrative anchors.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Designed as the onboarding campaign: 5-Titan selection, map objectives, enemy turns, and Gate sealing.
artDirectorNotes: Needs approved artwork for the First Reopening Gate, Mesha, Hollow Wretch, and TG-TITAN-001.
developmentDirectorNotes: Campaign can be expanded from current game/index.html without replacing the playable loop.
recommendedNextTask: Create chapter-select UI using campaign data.

name: Trial of the Celestial Heights
summary: Olympian and Asgardian laws collide over whether the reopened Gates should be treated as contests, oaths, or threats.
loreDirectorNotes: Preserves faction separation by presenting allied objectives without implying free faction mixing.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Adds environmental tests: storm lanes, arena platforms, and elite enemies.
artDirectorNotes: Needs Storm-Oath Bridge, Marble Sky Arena, Hrodda, Lyrion, and Forgotten Standard Bearer art.
developmentDirectorNotes: Requires map modifier support before becoming playable.

name: Roots Below the Gate
summary: Avalora reveals that Gates wound living terrain. The campaign shifts from simple sealing to restoration under pressure.
loreDirectorNotes: Defines living-map ethics without making the forest a generic nature backdrop.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Adds terrain memory and root movement rules.
artDirectorNotes: Needs Maeve Root-Memory and Moon-Grove Rootlabyrinth art.

name: Cinders of Dominion
summary: The Infernal Dominion treats Gate wounds as opportunity. The Creator must navigate bargains, execution sigils, and power without confusing ambition for corruption.
loreDirectorNotes: Keeps Infernal Dominion as a real civilization, not a generic evil faction.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Introduces risk/reward bargains and execution marks.
artDirectorNotes: Needs Vasha Cinder-Broker, Black Iron Court, and Infernal court asset prompts.

name: Helio-Kemet Sun Realm
summary: Aten Ra forces climb an S-shaped river-of-light campaign road from Sacred Sun Temple to the Titan Gate boss portal, establishing the campaign-map language for faction chapters.
loreDirectorNotes: Frames Aten Ra as solar law under siege by obsidian eclipse corruption. The boss gate silhouette is not a playable hero; it is a campaign apex threat.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Five-node mobile campaign structure with mission progress, star ratings, challenge node, and tactical battle handoff into a tiered Sun Realm gate map.
artDirectorNotes: Uses the Helio-Kemet campaign and battle references as locked layout guides: top-left chapter banner, top-right currency bar, left progress bar, S-path nodes, and peak boss gate.
developmentDirectorNotes: Use this campaign as the template for future faction campaign-map menus and tactical battle transitions.
recommendedNextTask: Convert campaign-map prompt into an interactive chapter-select prototype with five mission nodes.

name: Kami Mirror Tempest
summary: The Kami campaign travels through storm shrines, mirror lakes, and foxfire gates where every reflection can become a hostile tactical lane.
loreDirectorNotes: Focuses on contracts with spirits rather than conquest. The campaign tests whether the Creator can win without breaking local shrine law.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Map layouts favor shifting lanes, reflection decoys, wind pushes, cleanse objectives, and high-mobility enemy spirits.
artDirectorNotes: Vermilion torii gates, moonlit water, lacquer black shrine roofs, paper seals, foxfire blue, and mirror-surface battle grids.
developmentDirectorNotes: Ideal for testing terrain state changes and illusion markers after base tactical loop stabilizes.
recommendedNextTask: Prototype mirror-clone hazard tiles and wind-lane movement rules.

name: Empyrean Choir Vault
summary: The Empyrean campaign ascends luminous choir platforms orbiting a broken heaven-engine where harmonic gates rewrite battlefield elevation.
loreDirectorNotes: Presents Empyrean order as beautiful but dangerous: songs stabilize worlds while erasing dissonant survivors.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Map layouts emphasize vertical tiers, beacon timing, resonance shields, limited bridges, and boss pressure from the upper vault.
artDirectorNotes: Ivory-gold celestial architecture, blue-white auroras, floating glass stairs, halo mechanisms, and radiant tactical grids.
developmentDirectorNotes: Best used for testing elevation bonuses, timed beacons, and multi-tier mini-map clarity.
recommendedNextTask: Add elevation advantage rules and beacon countdown UI to the tactical prototype.
